e.title: **从保单特征一路走到**超赔再保分层**的车险定价全链**：仓库 `poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`——**⭐ 频率 GLM → 严重度**分段**（**小额与巨额分开**）→ **广义帕累托尾部** → **超赔分层评估** → **十万曝险年模拟****；**⭐ 三个可核数字**：**超过 €20,000 的赔案**不到 1% 却占约 **36% 的损失**；**Γ 离散参数从约 **25.3 降到 1.54**；**拟合尾部形状参数 **ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8**；**⚠️ 只有 5 个 notebook、无测试、无 `LICENSE`**
e.title_en: An end-to-end motor pricing chain running from policy characteristics all the way to excess-of-loss reinsurance layer assessment, with a frequency model, a severity split between attritional and large losses, a generalised-Pareto tail, layer comparison and a hundred-thousand exposure-year simulation, reporting that claims above twenty thousand euros were under one percent of claims yet about thirty-six percent of losses.
e.title_hk: **從保單特徵一路走到**超賠再保分層**的車險定價全鏈**：倉庫 `poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`——**⭐ 頻率 GLM → 嚴重度**分段**（**小額與巨額分開**）→ **廣義帕累托尾部** → **超賠分層評估** → **十萬曝險年模擬****；**⭐ 三個可核數字**：**超過 €20,000 的賠案**不到 1% 卻占約 **36% 的損失**；**Γ 離散參數從約 **25.3 降到 1.54**；**擬合尾部形狀參數 **ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8**；**⚠️ 只有 5 個 notebook、無測試、無 `LICENSE`**
e.summary: **motor-pricing-evt-xl**（`poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`）**是一份**端到端的车险定价与再保尾部风险分析****——**逐字自述为**「**This project develops an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework using the public `freMTPL2` French Motor Third-Party Liability dataset.**」**，**并逐字说明链条**「**combines claim frequency modelling, claim severity modelling, Extreme Value Theory and Monte Carlo simulation to move from individual policy risk characteristics through to aggregate portfolio loss and excess-of-loss reinsurance analysis**」**。**本次实测**：**创建与最后推送同为 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 只有 9 条路径**（**README ＋ `notebooks/` 下 02–06 五个 notebook**）**；**⚠️ 无 `requirements.txt`、**无测试、**无 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：拿上游当数据**」**——**它用已收录的 [[fremtpl2]] 数据集**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **把严重度**分成小额与巨额两段**，**并说明分段后模型稳定了多少**（**Γ 离散参数 25.3 → 1.54**）**；**② **用广义帕累托拟合**超过 €20,000 的尾部**，**如实报出极重的形状参数（**ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8**）与很大的不确定性**；**③ **用十万曝险年模拟比较**不同超赔分层的**期望成本与尾部削减**（**99% VaR 约 €55m**）**——**⭐ 并说明**历史燃烧成本在高层级**越来越不可信****。**⚠️ 本次未运行任何 notebook。
e.summary_hk: **motor-pricing-evt-xl**（`poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`）**是一份**端到端的車險定價與再保尾部風險分析****——**逐字自述為**「**This project develops an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework using the public `freMTPL2` French Motor Third-Party Liability dataset.**」**，**並逐字說明鏈條**「**combines claim frequency modelling, claim severity modelling, Extreme Value Theory and Monte Carlo simulation to move from individual policy risk characteristics through to aggregate portfolio loss and excess-of-loss reinsurance analysis**」**。**本次實測**：**建立與最後推送同為 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 只有 9 條路徑**（**README ＋ `notebooks/` 下 02–06 五個 notebook**）**；**⚠️ 無 `requirements.txt`、**無測試、**無 `LICENSE`**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：拿上游當資料**」**——**它用已收錄的 [[fremtpl2]] 資料集**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三處最值得看**：**① **把嚴重度**分成小額與巨額兩段**，**並說明分段後模型穩定了多少**（**Γ 離散參數 25.3 → 1.54**）**；**② **用廣義帕累托擬合**超過 €20,000 的尾部**，**如實報出極重的形狀參數（**ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8**）與很大的不確定性**；**③ **用十萬曝險年模擬比較**不同超賠分層的期望成本與尾部削減**（**99% VaR 約 €55m**）**。**⚠️ 本次未運行任何 notebook。
e.summary_en: The repository motor-insurance-pricing **is an end-to-end motor insurance pricing and reinsurance tail-risk analysis**, described verbatim as developing an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework on the public French motor third-party liability dataset, and combining claim frequency modelling, claim severity modelling, extreme value theory and Monte Carlo simulation to move from individual policy risk characteristics through to aggregate portfolio loss and excess-of-loss reinsurance analysis. **Measured this round**: **created and last pushed on the same day, 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily Jupyter notebooks, **only nine paths in the extracted archive** — a readme plus five notebooks numbered two through six — and **no requirements file, no tests and no licence file**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as data**, since it uses the pooled French motor third-party liability dataset. **Three things are worth reading**: severity is split into an attritional part and a large-loss part with a stated stability gain, the Gamma dispersion falling from about twenty-five to about one and a half; a generalised-Pareto tail is fitted above twenty thousand euros with an honestly heavy shape parameter of about zero point seven to zero point eight and substantial uncertainty around extreme-loss estimates; and a hundred thousand exposure-year simulation compares excess-of-loss layers by expected cost and tail-risk reduction, with historical burning cost becoming progressively less credible at higher attachment points. **No notebook was run this round.**
e.body:
**motor-insurance-pricing**（GitHub 仓库 `poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`）**是一份**端到端的车险定价与再保尾部风险分析****，**README 逐字自述为**「**This project develops an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework using the public `freMTPL2` French Motor Third-Party Liability dataset.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-10、最后推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**主语言 Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 只有 9 条路径**（**README.md、`.gitignore` 与** `notebooks/` **下 02–06 五个 notebook**）**；**⚠️ 无 `requirements.txt`、**无测试、**无 `LICENSE`**（**⭐ 本词条按惯例记为**权利不明**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**下游：拿上游当数据**」**——**它把本站已收录的 [[fremtpl2]] 数据集当作**输入端****。

**可核实信息（均 README 与文件清单实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 链条被一句逐字写清，**且每一段都有名字****——**逐字**：**「**The analysis covers three related insurance problems: 1. Claim frequency — modelling how policy characteristics affect the expected number of claims. 2. Claim severity — separating ordinary claims from large losses and modelling their different distributions. 3. Reinsurance and portfolio risk — using Extreme Value Theory (EVT) and Monte Carlo simulation to assess excess-of-loss reinsurance structures and their effect on extreme annual losses.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一结构值得抄的地方是**第三段的位置**：**它不是**另开一篇再保论文**，**而是**同一条链的终点**——**⭐ 即**定价模型与再保评估共用同一套频率与严重度假设**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 严重度被**分成两段**，**并给出分段前后模型稳定性的差值**——**逐字**：**「**A Poisson GLM with nonlinear age effects was used to model claim frequency, with Negative Binomial models used as a robustness check for overdispersion. Severity was separated into attritional and large-loss components after identifying that a very small number of claims accounted for a disproportionate share of total losses.**」**，**并给出**「**Gamma dispersion falling from approximately 25.3 to 1.54 below the €20,000 threshold**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**「**为什么要分段**」**不是一句直觉，**而是**一个从 25.3 降到 1.54 的数**——**⭐ 即**分段的有效性**被量化了**；**⭐ 这与本站第 330 轮「**假设**」、第 343 轮「**四个维度**」同向**：**假设要能被检验**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 尾部被明确承认是**极重的**，**且不确定性被写出****——**逐字**：**「**The fitted Generalised Pareto tail had a shape parameter of approximately ξ = 0.7–0.8, indicating a very heavy Pareto-type tail with substantial uncertainty around extreme-loss estimates.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得记**：**ξ 在 **0.7–0.8** 时**均值的有限性都取决于**方差之外的条件**（**⭐ 本词条只转述其自述，**不在此推导**）**；**⭐ 而作者**没有**把这样一个参数说得比它更确定**——**⭐ 并**据此指出**历史燃烧成本在高层级越来越不可信**（**逐字**「**Historical burning cost became progressively less credible at higher reinsurance attachment points because very few claims reached those layers.**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 三个与业务直接相关的数字**——**逐字**：**① **风险区分度**（**「**observed annual claim frequency rising from approximately 4.4% in the lowest predicted-risk decile to 31.5% in the highest**」**）**；**② **奖惩系数（Bonus-Malus）的强度**（**「**a 10-point increase was associated with approximately 25% higher expected claim frequency, holding other rating factors constant**」**）**；**③ **集中度**（**「**Claims above €20,000 represented less than 1% of claims but approximately 36% of total losses**」**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为第 ③ 条是整篇的核心事实**：**不到 1% 的赔案占约 36% 的损失**——**⭐ 即**小额模型再精细，**也管不到那 36%**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 再保那一侧的比较口径被写明**——**逐字**：**「**For a simulated portfolio of 100,000 exposure-years, gross annual 99% VaR stabilised at approximately €55m, while 99% TVaR was materially more sensitive to extreme simulated losses. Higher-attaching excess-of-loss layers generated fewer recoveries and lower expected cost, but provided more targeted protection against severe losses per euro of expected ceded loss.**」**。**⭐ 即**比较不只看**期望成本**，**还看**每一元分出保费的尾部保护效率**——**⭐ 这与本站第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**层越高，**数据越少，**结论越弱**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 数据审计留下了一处具体的**不对劲****——**逐字**：**「**The severity table contained 195 claim records linked to six policy IDs absent from the frequency table. These claims were retained during the initial data audit and sensitivity analysis, but excluded from the primary covariate and reinsurance models to maintain a consistent portfolio population.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**它**发现了**左右表对不上的 **195 条**，**没有**悄悄删掉**，**而是**分两处处理**（**审计与敏感性分析里保留、**主模型里排除**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 341 轮「**三种缺席**」同向**：**缺席要分类，**而不是**一律抹平**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 数据规模与工程形态（如实记录）**：**逐字**「**678,013 policy records**」**与**「**26,639 claim severity records**」**；**notebook 编号从 **02 起**（**没有 01**）**；**`notebooks/` 五个文件的实测大小为** 43,670／180,934／91,671／184,457／241,654 **字节**；**⚠️ 全仓库**没有 `.py` 源文件、**没有测试、**没有依赖清单**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**要复现需自备环境，**且** README 未逐字给出依赖清单**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[fremtpl2]] 与 [[fremtpl2-python-tutorial]] 覆盖该数据集与其教程**，**[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、**[[fremtpl2]] 相关条目覆盖 Tweedie 定价**，**[[pyextremes]]、**[[mev]]、**[[extremes]]、**[[evd]]、**[[evir]] 覆盖极值统计工具**，**[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]] 覆盖再保分层定价**，**[[cat-bond-pricing]]、**[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]] 覆盖再保一侧**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**频率 → 严重度分段 → 帕累托尾部 → 超赔分层 → 十万曝险年模拟**」这一条完整链，**且**每一步都留了可核数字**。**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[fremtpl2]]、[[pyextremes]] 应当并读**——**前者给数据，**中者给极值工具，**本条给**一条把它们串起来并走到再保的完整例子**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的三点**：**① 严重度分段要**用稳定性指标验证**，**而不是**凭直觉**；**② 尾部分布拟合出很重的参数时**照写**，**并写出不确定性**；**③ 左右表对不上时**分类处理**，**不悄悄删数据**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次没有运行该项目任何一步**（**未打开任何 notebook、**未执行任何单元、**未复算任何 GLM、**帕累托拟合或模拟**），**故**不主张**其 4.4%／31.5%、**25.3→1.54、**ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8、**36%、**99% VaR ≈ €55m **中的任何一个数字**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未读任何 notebook 正文**——**本次只读** `README.md` **与 tarball 路径与大小列表**；**⭐ 故**本词条所述的一切**模型设定、**阈值与结论**都只来自 README 的自述**，**未经我核对**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实 `freMTPL2` 的**实际取数版本与来源**（**⭐ 未确认它是经由 OpenML、**经 [[fremtpl2]] 的镜像、**还是**作者自行拼接**）**；**也未核实** 678,013／26,639 **这两个行数与公开版本是否一致**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实「**€20,000**」这一分段阈值是如何选出的**（**⭐ 是**最小化某准则**、**还是**试出来的**，**README 未逐字说明**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实** 100,000 **曝险年的模拟次数与随机种子**（**⭐ README 未逐字给出可复现细节**）**；**⭐ 故**该 VaR 数字**本次**不可复现**。**⑥ ⚠️ **权利不明**：**仓库内未见 `LICENSE`，**README 亦未逐字给出许可条款****（**⭐ 这**不等于**作者放弃权利**）**；**⚠️ 复用其代码、**图表或数字前**须先取得作者许可**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实作者身份与机构**；**★0、**创建与推送同日、**无测试、**无 CI、**五个 notebook 无 `01`**——**⭐ 本词条如实指出**：**这是一个**单次作品集式分析**，**不是**可维护的软件**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核实其结论与公开文献是否一致**（**⭐ 例如**车险严重度分段阈值与帕累托形状参数的常见取值范围**）**；**本条**不主张**其估计优于或劣于任何已发表结果**。**⑨ ⚠️ 创建 2026-09-10 在窗口之内**（**本条的创建与推送都在解冻窗口内**）**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**其全部数字**均为**该项目在其自有数据与自定参数上的自述结果**，**不得**用于任何真实定价、**再保分层决策或资本计量**。

e.body_hk:
**motor-insurance-pricing**（GitHub 倉庫 `poohbear4/motor-insurance-pricing`）**是一份**端到端的車險定價與再保尾部風險分析****，**README 逐字自述為**「**This project develops an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework using the public `freMTPL2` French Motor Third-Party Liability dataset.**」**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-09-10、最後推送 2026-09-10**、**★0**、**Jupyter Notebook**；**tarball 只有 9 條路徑**（**README.md、`.gitignore` 與** `notebooks/` **下 02–06 五個 notebook**）**；**⚠️ 無 `requirements.txt`、**無測試、**無 `LICENSE`**（**按慣例記為**權利不明**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**下游：拿上游當資料**」**——**它把已收錄的 [[fremtpl2]] 資料集當作**輸入端****。

**可核實資訊（均 README 與文件清單實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 鏈條被一句逐字寫清，**且每段都有名字****——**逐字三個問題**：**頻率（**保單特徵如何影響預計賠案數**）／**嚴重度（**把小額與巨額分開、**各自建模**）／**再保與組合風險（**用極值理論與蒙地卡羅評估超賠結構對極端年度損失的影響**）**。**⭐ 值得抄的地方是**第三段的位置**：**它不是**另開一篇再保論文**，**而是**同一條鏈的終點**——**定價模型與再保評估共用同一套頻率與嚴重度假設**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 嚴重度被**分成兩段**，**並給出分段前後模型穩定性的差值****——**逐字**「**Severity was separated into attritional and large-loss components after identifying that a very small number of claims accounted for a disproportionate share of total losses.**」**，**並給出**「**Gamma dispersion falling from approximately 25.3 to 1.54 below the €20,000 threshold**」**。**⭐ 本詞條認為這是本輪最值得抄的一處**：**「**為什麼要分段**」**不是直覺，**而是**一個從 25.3 降到 1.54 的數**——**分段的有效性**被量化了**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 尾部被明確承認**極重**，**且不確定性被寫出****——**逐字**「**The fitted Generalised Pareto tail had a shape parameter of approximately ξ = 0.7–0.8, indicating a very heavy Pareto-type tail with substantial uncertainty around extreme-loss estimates.**」**；**⭐ 而作者**沒有**把這個參數說得比它更確定**，**並據此指出**歷史燃燒成本在越高層級越不可信**（**逐字**「**Historical burning cost became progressively less credible at higher reinsurance attachment points because very few claims reached those layers.**」**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 三個與業務直接相關的數字**：**風險區分度**（**最低十分位約 **4.4%**，**最高十分位約 **31.5%****）**、**獎懲係數強度**（**+10 點對應約 **25% 更高**的預計賠案頻率，**其他評分因子不變**）**、**集中度**（**超過 €20,000 的賠案**不到 1% 卻占約 **36% 的總損失****）**。**⭐ 第 ③ 條是全篇核心事實**：**不到 1% 的賠案占約 36% 的損失**——**小額模型再精細，**也管不到那 36%****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 再保比較口徑被寫明**：**十萬曝險年的模擬中，**毛年度 99% VaR 穩定在約 **€55m****，**而 99% TVaR 對極端模擬損失**顯著更敏感****；**層級越高**回收越少、**期望成本越低**，**但**每一元分出保費帶來的尾部保護更集中****。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 資料審計留下一處具體的**不對勁****——**逐字**「**The severity table contained 195 claim records linked to six policy IDs absent from the frequency table. These claims were retained during the initial data audit and sensitivity analysis, but excluded from the primary covariate and reinsurance models to maintain a consistent portfolio population.**」**——**⭐ 即**發現左右表對不上的 **195 條**，**沒有悄悄刪掉**，**而是**分兩處處理**：**審計與敏感性分析保留、**主模型排除**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 資料規模與工程形態（如實記錄）**：**678,013 筆保單**與** 26,639 筆嚴重度紀錄**；**notebook 編號由 **02 起**（**無 01**）**；**五個 notebook 實測為** 43,670／180,934／91,671／184,457／241,654 **位元組**；**⚠️ 全倉庫**無 `.py`、**無測試、**無依賴清單**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 與池內條目的關係**：[[fremtpl2]]、[[fremtpl2-python-tutorial]]、[[insurance-pricing-tweedie]]、[[pyextremes]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]、[[evd]]、[[evir]]、[[rs-ins-reinsurance-layer-pricing]]、[[cat-bond-pricing]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**頻率 → 嚴重度分段 → 帕累托尾部 → 超賠分層 → 十萬曝險年模擬**」這一條完整鏈**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[fremtpl2]]、[[pyextremes]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 三點最值得借鑑**：**① 嚴重度分段要**用穩定性指標驗證**；**② 尾部擬合出很重的參數時**照寫**，**並寫出不確定性**；**③ 左右表對不上時**分類處理**，**不悄悄刪資料**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次沒有運行該專案任何一步**（**未打開任何 notebook、**未執行任何單元、**未複算任何 GLM、**帕累托擬合或模擬**），**不主張**其任何數字**（**含** 4.4%／31.5%、**25.3→1.54、**ξ ≈ 0.7–0.8、**36%、**99% VaR ≈ €55m**）**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未讀任何 notebook 正文**——**只讀** `README.md` **與 tarball 路徑與大小列表**；**⭐ 故**本詞條所述的一切**模型設定、**閾值與結論**都只來自 README 自述**，**未經我核對**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實 `freMTPL2` 的**實際取數版本與來源**；**未核實** 678,013／26,639 **這兩個行數與公開版本是否一致**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**「**€20,000**」**這一分段閾值如何選出**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實** 100,000 **曝險年的模擬次數與隨機種子**——**⭐ 故**該 VaR 數字**本次**不可複現**。**⑥ ⚠️ **權利不明**：**未見 `LICENSE`、**README 未逐字給出許可條款****（**⭐ **這不等於**作者放棄權利**）**；**⚠️ 複用前須先取得作者許可**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實作者身份與機構**；**★0、**建立與推送同日、**無測試、**無 CI、**五個 notebook 無 01**——**⭐ 這是**單次作品集式分析**，**不是**可維護的軟體**。**⑧ ⚠️ 未核實其結論與公開文獻是否一致**；**不主張**其估計優於或劣於任何已發表結果**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立 2026-09-10 在窗口之內**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 其全部數字**均為**該專案在其自有資料與自定參數上的自述結果**，**不得**用於任何真實定價、**再保分層決策或資本計量**。

e.body_en:
The repository motor-insurance-pricing, by the GitHub user poohbear4, **is an end-to-end motor insurance pricing and reinsurance tail-risk analysis**, described verbatim as developing an end-to-end motor insurance risk modelling framework on the public French motor third-party liability dataset. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-10**, **last pushed 2026-09-10**, **zero stars**, primarily Jupyter notebooks, **only nine paths in the extracted archive**, and **no requirements file, no tests and no licence file**, which this entry records as unclear rights. **This entry belongs to the round theme of the downstream using the upstream as data.**

**Verified information, all measured from the README and the file listing**: **first, the chain is stated in one verbatim sentence and each link has a name**: claim frequency modelling of how policy characteristics affect the expected number of claims, claim severity separating ordinary claims from large losses and modelling their different distributions, and reinsurance and portfolio risk using extreme value theory and Monte Carlo simulation to assess excess-of-loss structures and their effect on extreme annual losses. **What is worth copying here is the position of the third stage: reinsurance assessment is the endpoint of the same chain rather than a separate paper, so the pricing model and the reinsurance assessment share one set of frequency and severity assumptions.** **Second, severity is split in two and the stability gain is quantified**: verbatim, a Poisson generalised linear model with nonlinear age effects was used for frequency with negative binomial models as a robustness check for overdispersion, and severity was separated into attritional and large-loss components after identifying that a very small number of claims accounted for a disproportionate share of total losses, with the Gamma dispersion falling from about twenty-five to about one and a half below the twenty-thousand-euro threshold. **The reason for splitting is therefore not an intuition but a number, which is how an assumption becomes testable.** **Third, the tail is explicitly acknowledged as very heavy with the uncertainty written out**: verbatim, the fitted generalised-Pareto tail had a shape parameter of about zero point seven to zero point eight, indicating a very heavy Pareto-type tail with substantial uncertainty around extreme-loss estimates. **The author does not state such a parameter more confidently than it deserves, and draws the practical consequence verbatim: historical burning cost became progressively less credible at higher reinsurance attachment points because very few claims reached those layers.** **Fourth, three business-facing numbers**: out-of-sample risk differentiation, with observed annual claim frequency rising from about four and a half percent in the lowest predicted-risk decile to about thirty-one and a half percent in the highest; the strength of the bonus-malus factor, where a ten-point increase was associated with about twenty-five percent higher expected claim frequency holding other rating factors constant; and concentration, where claims above twenty thousand euros were under one percent of claims but about thirty-six percent of total losses. **That last figure is the core fact of the whole project: under one percent of claims carry about thirty-six percent of the losses, so no amount of refinement on the attritional side reaches that thirty-six percent.** **Fifth, the reinsurance comparison states its own yardstick**: verbatim, for a simulated portfolio of a hundred thousand exposure-years the gross annual ninety-nine percent value at risk stabilised at about fifty-five million euros while the corresponding tail value at risk was materially more sensitive to extreme simulated losses, and higher-attaching layers generated fewer recoveries and lower expected cost but provided more targeted protection against severe losses per euro of expected ceded loss. **The comparison therefore looks not only at expected cost but at tail protection per unit of ceded premium.** **Sixth, the data audit leaves one concrete discrepancy on the record**: verbatim, the severity table contained one hundred and ninety-five claim records linked to six policy identifiers absent from the frequency table, and those claims were retained during the initial data audit and sensitivity analysis but excluded from the primary covariate and reinsurance models to maintain a consistent portfolio population. **Finding a cross-table mismatch and handling it in two different places rather than quietly deleting it is the same discipline as naming the different kinds of absence instead of flattening them.** **Seventh, data scale and engineering shape, recorded plainly**: about six hundred and seventy-eight thousand policy records and about twenty-six and a half thousand severity records; notebooks numbered from two, with no notebook one; notebook sizes of roughly forty-four, a hundred and eighty-one, ninety-two, a hundred and eighty-four and two hundred and forty-two kilobytes; and **no Python module, no test and no dependency list anywhere in the repository, so reproducing it requires assembling the environment yourself**. **Eighth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the dataset and its tutorial, Tweedie pricing, extreme-value tooling, reinsurance layer pricing and reinsurance contract repositories, **while this entry supplies one complete chain from frequency through a severity split, a Pareto tail, excess-of-loss layers and a hundred-thousand exposure-year simulation, with a checkable number left at every step. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled dataset and the pooled extreme-value tooling**; **three practices transfer directly: verify a severity split with a stability statistic rather than an intuition, write a fitted tail parameter out even when it is uncomfortably heavy and state its uncertainty, and handle cross-table mismatches by classifying them instead of deleting rows**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no step of the project was run** — no notebook opened, no cell executed, no generalised linear model, Pareto fit or simulation recomputed — **so none of the reported figures, including the frequency-range percentages, the dispersion values, the tail shape parameter, the loss concentration share or the simulated value at risk, is claimed**. **Second, no notebook body was read**: only the README and the archive path and size listing were read, so **every model setting, threshold and conclusion stated here comes from the README alone and was not checked by this entry**; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual vintage and route of the dataset were not verified, nor was the number of rows compared against any public version. Fourth, how the twenty-thousand-euro split threshold was selected was not verified.** **Fifth, the number of simulation runs and the random seed behind the hundred-thousand exposure-year simulation were not verified, so that figure is not reproducible from this entry.** **Sixth, the rights position is unclear**: no licence file is present and the README gives no licence terms verbatim, **which is not the same as the author waiving rights**, so reuse of code, figures or numbers requires the author permission first. **Seventh, the author identity and affiliation were not verified, and a repository with zero stars, same-day creation and push, no tests, no continuous integration and no first notebook is a one-off portfolio analysis rather than maintainable software. Eighth, no comparison against published literature was made, and this entry claims neither superiority nor inferiority to any published estimate. Ninth, the creation date of 2026-09-10 is inside the thaw window, so this entry has no window exception to declare. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that all of its figures are the project own reported results on its own data and chosen parameters and must not be used for any real pricing, reinsurance layer decision or capital calculation.**
